REGENERATIVE RANCHING

Being good stewards of the land is a top priority here at Caitlyn Farms!

We implement many regenerative agricultural practices and stick to a strict rotational grazing plan to  help improve our farms soil, water, plant diversity and wildlife habitat.

Did you know Caitlyn Farms is home to its very own Wildlife Management Area?

Click below to see how we are working to bridge the gap between Farming and Wildlife Conservation!

TASTE THE DIFFERENCE

Feel good about where your food comes from!

Caitlyn Farms Sustainably Raised Beef offers meat that is:

 Local
Humanely Raised
100% Grassfed
Grazed with native fish and wildlife in mind

We are proud to be an American Grassfed Certified Producer, Certified Appalachian Grown and Animal Welfare Approved!

Place an order, find us at your local farmers market or purchase select cuts at your neighborhood farm store.

HAPPY HERD

Better Beef From Happy Cows!

We strive for our cattle to live the best life they possibly can on our farm. The herd is rotated to lush new pastures daily, which provides fresh legumes and grasses for grazing.

Home is where the herd is!

Caitlyn Farms cattle spend their entire life on our farm from birth to harvest.

Staff constantly monitor herd health and behavior to ensure our cows are safe, happy and healthy.

Follow us on Facebook, TikTok and Instagram to keep up with our herd!

PRICE SHEETS

PRICE SHEETS UPDATED QUARTERLY VIA USDA NC GRASS FED REPORT

There are many factors at play when getting beef from our farm to your table, and we want to provide our customers with the best prices possible!

Price sheets are reviewed and adjusted each quarter to keep up with market trends, processing costs, diesel prices, supply chain disruptions and extreme weather events.

All prices are based off of the median price given in the USDA (Monthly) North Carolina Grass Fed Beef Report.
